The pulse changes the admissible physical experiment and suppresses slow directions. No transfer to arbitrary DC,unfiltered voltage,instantaneous feedback or prior interface optima. N1683 m=1 pulse has a2/3 memory floor without invalidating its specialized stability/work guarantees;no improvement of that work optimum is established. Passivity alone is insufficient: weakly damped oscillators break fixed-pulse uniformity. First-moment leakage restores a floor;net-charge leakage destroys the arbitrarily-slow-mode bound. Harmonic-leak tolerance is a supplied calibration condition,not measured hardware or part of the ideal execution. TV controls bounded observed-record events,not unbounded expected work or unobserved state.
